mapper.sql: select p.plan_id, p.plan_name, p.elevator_id, p.maintain_type, p.cycle_days, p.template_name, p.start_date, p.end_date, p.next_date, p.last_date, p.owner_id, p.plan_status, p.expect_count, p.finish_count, p.del_flag, p.create_by, p.create_time, p.update_by, p.update_time, p.remark, e.elevator_code as elevator_code, e.unit_no as unit_no, b.building_no as building_no, b.community_id as community_id, c.community_name as community_name, u.nick_name as owner_name, timestampdiff(day, sysdate(), p.next_date) as remaining_days from maintain_plan p left join elevator e on p.elevator_id = e.elevator_id left join building b on e.building_id = b.building_id left join community c on b.community_id = c.community_id left join sys_user u on p.owner_id = u.user_id
mapper.select: where p.del_flag = '0' and p.plan_status = '0' and p.next_date is not null and p.next_date <= sysdate() and (p.end_date is null or p.end_date >= sysdate()) order by p.next_date

where p.del_flag = '0' and p.plan_status = '0' and p.next_date is not null and p.next_date <= date_add(sysdate(), interval #{dueSoonDays} day) and (p.end_date is null or p.end_date >= sysdate()) order by p.next_date
select ifnull(sum(expect_count), 0) as expectCount, ifnull(sum(finish_count), 0) as finishCount from maintain_plan where del_flag = '0' and elevator_id = #{elevatorId}
select count(1) from maintain_plan where del_flag = '0'
mapper.update: update maintain_plan set last_date = #{lastDate}, next_date = #{nextDate}, finish_count = finish_count + 1, expect_count = expect_count + 1, update_time = sysdate() where plan_id = #{planId}
